name: phonenumbers-shortnumberinfo
instr:
I'm restoring short number support in our copy of the phonenumbers Go library. We use it to tell whether a dialed string is an emergency number, whether a short code is valid, and what it costs the caller (toll-free, standard rate, premium, carrier-specific, SMS service). The functions in `shortnumberinfo.go` currently panic, as do `MatchNationalNumber` in `internal/regexbasedmatcher/regexbasedmatcher.go` and a few `PhoneMetadata` getters in `metadata/phonemetadata.pb.go`. Could you implement them so the short number API works for every region in the bundled metadata?

The doc comments on those functions are the contract; please follow them exactly, because call routing depends on the emergency and cost answers.

Please keep every existing name and signature as it is, exported or not: the tests call unexported declarations in `shortnumberinfo.go` (`shortNumberRegionToMetadataMap`, `readFromShortNumberRegionToMetadataMap`, `writeToShortNumberRegionToMetadataMap`, `getShortNumberMetadataForRegion`, `getExampleShortNumber`, `getExampleShortNumberForCost`, `matchesPossibleNumberAndNationalNumber`). Only helpers you add are up to you.
I'll run the package's own tests, and the rest of the module's tests must keep passing.

In the non-test code you add, please avoid: new `init()` functions; the `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `runtime/trace`, `testing` and `flag` packages, cgo, and `//go:linkname` or `//go:emb
